note: Opportunity cost = daily wage x hearings x days-per-hearing. The wage is the notified rural employment-guarantee wage (VB-G RAM G Act 2025 / ex-MGNREGA), used as a transparent floor for a day lost to a court visit. Urban and informal incomes are often higher; the user can enter their own daily wage and the app labels the fallback.
source: PIB press release (30 Jun 2026): 'national average notified wage has increased from ₹298.8 per day under MGNREGA to ₹327.4 per day under VB-G RAM G'; '₹300 interim base wage rate, ensuring that no notified wage is below ₹300 per day.'

stateWages.source: PIB release places Karnataka in the 'over Rs 360 up to Rs 409' band without a single published figure in this summary — shown as band, exact figure not yet sourced.

fallback: When a State's notified wage is not in the sourced table, the estimator uses the national average and labels it 'national average — State wage not yet sourced'.
